party.layout: Full roster grid + timer + phase banner ('Mingle. Introduce yourself.'). No map, no clues — nothing has happened yet.

murder_cinematic.layout: White flash → lightning crack audio → the scream → cut to black → the announcement text. Overrides everything for 3 minutes.

investigation.layout: Three-panel: MAP (left), CLUE FEED (right), ROSTER (bottom strip). Header: round name, countdown, phase instruction, tamper announce banner when active.

trial.layout: Full takeover: nominee photos large, open-vote tally as anonymous silhouettes until close, 45s defense timer per nominee, then conviction reveal cards. Ghost reaction emoji float up the sides.

reveal.layout: The reconstruction, then faction-by-faction reveals per story_beats reveal order, then the winners screen, then the stats screen.

status_states.convicted: greyscale + revealed card label (KILLER / SYNDICATE ASSOCIATE / GUEST per reveal policy) + a small ghost icon
status_states.braun: James Braun's portrait gains a black ribbon after the murder. He stays on the board all night.

map.shows: Floor plan, west wing greyed out. Each zone's clue spot renders as: UNSEARCHED (dim pin) / FOUND (lit pin, links to clue feed entry). Pins pulse for 30s when a new clue is scanned.
map.note: Zone occupancy of players is NEVER shown. The map tracks evidence, not people — badge data stays with the engine.

clue_feed.shows: Every scanned clue: zone name, clue title, full current text, finder's character name, scan timestamp.
clue_feed.version_rule: The feed displays the LATEST-SCANNED version of each clue's text. Tampering does not auto-update the board — the lie propagates only when someone physically re-scans the clue. Forensics results are never shown here; they go to the detective's phone alone.
clue_feed.finder_note: Finder visibility is a deliberate knob: it credits hunters, and it makes re-scanning a tampered clue a public act. Flip to anonymous if playtest shows scan-shyness.

tamper_banner.shows: 'A CLUE HAS BEEN TAMPERED WITH' — persistent banner from the round after any tamper, per existing announce rules. Never says which clue, which round it happened, or how many.
tamper_banner.design_intent: The room re-reads the whole feed and argues about what changed. Players who photographed or noted early clue text become suddenly valuable.

main_screen.data_sources: Roster from registration flow. Map/clue feed from the clue-scan graph. Status from trial results + reveal policy (rounds.json). Trial panels from the vote service. Ghost overlay from the ghost message service.
